- When sentiment is positive (≥0.67) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast slightly.
- After a price spike, model often overshoots and fails to correct — cap forecast at 1–2% above recent peak.
- If sentiment is negative (≤0.33) and price is falling, model underestimates — adjust up by 0.5–1.5% to avoid premature bottoming.
- Model consistently underestimates in early 30d horizon when sentiment is mixed or neutral — add 0.8–1.2% to forecast to account for lag.
- If last 3–5 days show strong downward momentum, model often fails to reflect mean reversion — add 0.5–1.0% to forecast to signal rebound.
- When sentiment is high and price is near 80+, model tends to overreact — cap forecast at 82.5% of 30d high or 80.0+ with 1% buffer.
